title: sambucus sibirica subsp. miquelii
intro: Sambucus sibirica subsp. miquelii, commonly known as the Japanese elderberry or Miquel's elder, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Adoxaceae. It is a shrub native to East Asia, known for its medicinal properties and health benefits, which include relieving symptoms of upper respiratory tract infections, such as the common cold and flu, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Sambucus sibirica subsp. miquelii include acting as an antiviral, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory agent, which can help to boost the immune system and reduce the severity of symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sambunigrin, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
